title: Generative Structure from Motion with Native 3D Diffusion
abstract: arXiv:2610.35522v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recovering an object's 3D structure and camera motion from a few uncalibrated views is a fundamental problem in computer vision. Classical structure from motion methods recover 3D geometry consistent with the input images but cannot recover unseen regions; native generation methods produce plausible 3D objects which are related but not necessarily faithful to the input images. Methods simply concatenating reconstruction and generation allow error to cascade across the two stages, instead of producing a 3D object consistent with both the distribution and the input. We propose GenSfM, which integrates image-based 3D reconstruction with a native 3D diffusion model. In particular, we use a multi-modal diffusion transformer to jointly denoise the shape latent and per-view pose latents under shared self-attention, grounding generated geometry in the observed views while using object-level priors to infer unobserved regions. translated_title: 基于原生3D扩散的生成式运动恢复结构
translated_abstract: 从少量未标定视角恢复物体的三维结构与相机运动是计算机视觉中的一个基本问题。经典的运动恢复结构方法能够恢复与输入图像一致的三维几何，但无法恢复未见区域；原生生成方法可以产生看似合理的三维物体，但这些物体与输入图像相关却未必忠实于输入。而简单地将重建与生成串联的方法会导致误差在两个阶段之间级联传播，无法生成既符合数据分布又与输入一致的三维物体。我们提出GenSfM，它将基于图像的三维重建与原生三维扩散模型相集成。特别地，我们使用一个多模态扩散Transformer，在共享自注意力机制下联合去噪形状潜变量和每个视角的位姿潜变量，使生成的几何锚定于观测视角，同时利用物体级先验来推断未被观测的区域。
tldr: GenSfM将基于图像的三维重建与原生3D扩散模型融合，利用多模态扩散Transformer在共享自注意力下联合去噪物体形状与各视角相机位姿，使生成的几何既忠实于输入图像，又能借助物体级先验补全未见区域。
en_tdlr: GenSfM integrates image-based 3D reconstruction with a native 3D diffusion model, using a multi-modal diffusion transformer to jointly denoise shape and per-view pose latents so that generated geometry stays faithful to the input views while object-level priors infer unobserved regions.
